title: Utility Order for Dixie Electric Membership Corporation, ex parte. — Order No. U-37861 accepts the Joint Report for the 2025 Test Year Rate Stabilization Plan filing submitted on July 1, 2026, which states that a decrease in rates for a revenue decrease of $ 2,377,160 is necessary and in accordance with the terms of Dixie Electric Membership Corporation’s Formula Rate Plan. This matter was considered at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.
